verdict.rationale: A permissioned, diligence-ready data room is a fair capability to ask of an equity-management platform, but the evidence never documents one. Nothing shows sharing cap table views together with underlying documents to counsel or investors under per-recipient permissions. The cap table API endpoints and OAuth-based law-firm access (carta-docs-25, carta-docs-18) are developer building blocks for fetching data, not a product data-room feature.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors
